name: OPPAI Life - Ohayou kara Oyasumi made Momisui Seikatsu
original_name: OPPAIライフ おはようからおやすみまで揉み吸い生活
source:
Naoto is a university student. One day, he meets Ayane, his old friend, by chance after an interval of several years. Also, Chika, his old friend as well, suddenly appears in front of him. She tells him to become her tutor and they start living together...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081028092658/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009272]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
直人是一名大学生。某天，时隔数年，他偶然遇见儿时玩伴绫音。另一名旧友千花也突然出现在他面前，要求他做自己的家教，于是他们开始同居……
